title: Tomioka Giyu Katana
description: This resource pack allows you to replace the texture of any sword with Tomioka Giya's katana by renaming it.
body: This resource pack allows you to replace the texture of any sword with Giyu Tomioka katana by renaming it.This resource pack will allow you to feel like an anime character.When the katana is in the right hand, it is open, and when it is in the left hand, it is closed. In order for the resource to work, you need Optifine or CIT Resewn.May also work on newer versions.
